moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-vhs-scanline, written here): Overlay: 1 px dark scanline every 2 px (15 %; demo 38 %, phase flips at 30 fps); a noise band 6 % (demo 9 %) of the frame height rolls top → bottom every 3 s linear, its rows (4 sub-bands) shifted ±7 px, seeded per 24 fps frame, with a light wash and white dashes; every 2–4 s (demo once per loop, CSS 3.2 s) the picture jumps −7 / +4 / −2 / +1 px over 4 frames with a dark edge bar; chroma bleed red −2 / cyan +2 px at ~80 % screen (4 px in a jump). Loop 3 s. Params: scanlines: vân quét (2 px) · band: dải nhiễu (6–9 %, 3 s một lượt) · jump: giật hình (mỗi 2–4 s) · chroma (±2 px).
